$comment: Known failures of the Pod encryption vectors, per implementation. Same rules as the repository's top-level KNOWN_FAILURES.json, applied by scripts/check_pod_encryption.py instead of scripts/check_baseline.py: entries are keyed on (vector, reason) for the implementation the harness drives; a failure that is not listed fails the run AND a listed failure that starts passing fails the run, so the list can only shrink deliberately. Entries marked measured: false are for an implementation this harness cannot run (it is not public); they were derived by reading its code, are reported but not ratcheted, and must be confirmed by that implementation's own test suite running these vectors.
measuredWith: cascade-cli 0.22.0 with the-cascade-protocol/cascade-cli#117 (branch fix/pod-path-safety at 565c6cd): 92 passed, 0 failed; no cascade-cli entries remain

entries.detail: By code inspection: a 1.1 wrap with no label member is read as label null (spec 4.3 requires the member).
By code inspection: a 1.1 wrap with no createdAt member is read as createdAt null (spec 4.3 requires the member).
By code inspection: an unimplemented 1.1 wrap with no label or createdAt is accepted (spec 4.3).
By code inspection: members of an unimplemented wrap (kdf, kdfParams, wrappedDek) are type-checked, so an unexpected shape refuses the header (spec 4.3 says they are not read).
By code inspection: a 1.0 wrap whose label is not a string refuses the header; 1.0 defines no label and unknown members are ignored (spec 4.4).
